tool_input.command:
git add DESIGN.md && git commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs(design): correct the shipped-target list in DES-077 addendum 3

The #10 entry enumerated shipped targets as darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64,
and linux/arm64 — wrong in two independent directions. `make dist`
(Makefile:196-199) builds four binaries, including linux/amd64, which
the list omitted; an earlier draft of the same list also claimed
windows/amd64, which `make dist` does not build at all.

The Windows half was corrected in 4ac9f7b. This corrects the other
half and states the distinction explicitly, because it is load-bearing
rather than pedantic: M4's "WARN is the ceiling" rationale for the
unsupported-platform branch rests on Windows being a
build-verification target that is never distributed, so a target list
that quietly promotes it to shipped undercuts the reasoning that
depends on it.

All five verified at exit 0 before this claim was written: the four
`make dist` targets plus windows/amd64.
EOF
)"
